reviewer: Claude (visual inspection of the contact sheets: views, forms, closeups, plus stats.json)
notes: v1 is the jerrycan as it exists in build_props4.py. This review replaces review_superseded_1.json, which was written from renders that showed the collision hull over the model (harness bug, fixed).

defects.text: Body is a pillow: the broad faces bow outward and the vertical edges are pinched, so the side view is a hexagon instead of a rectangle with rounded edges.
defects.fix: Rebuild as a rounded box: flat faces, flat top, 2 cm fillets.

defects.text: Handle is one solid block set off-centre: no three-bar grip openings, the can's defining feature.
defects.fix: Four posts and three grip openings along the top.

defects.text: The X and rails are flat bars laid on the surface like planks; the upper rail overshoots the panel edge and the bars stand clear of the surface in the side views. They are not pressed ribs.
defects.fix: Low trapezoid ribs half-sunk into the face, inside a pressed frame.

defects.text: Paint is a coarse mottled green with large orange rust blotches that read as camouflage; real wear sits at edges, seam and handle. No Kraftstoff 20 L stencil.
defects.fix: Needs a purpose-made can paint texture with edge wear and stencils.

defects.text: Spout is a bare grey cylinder: no flip cap, cam lever or retainer ring.
No recessed seam around the middle of the narrow faces (Wikipedia: recessed welded seam).
defects.fix: Shallow groove along y = 0 over top, ends and bottom.

defects.text: Height is 0.490 m against 0.46 +-0.012 m (numeric check fails).
Nine material slots attached, two used: 87.8 MB of texture memory for a 0.35 m prop.
